svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 10 · Santa Cruz · 02/12 The Great Meadow (Rare)
svg.desc: A long grass slope near the entrance. Walk up it, turn around, and the whole bay is waiting. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
